metadata.title: A lifting defect for oriented $t_3$ and $\bar t_6$ moves
metadata.abstract: We study oriented $t_3$- and $\bar t_6$-moves through the problem of lifting Fox $3$-colorings to colorings by a nine-element Alexander quandle. We define a nonnegative integer lifting defect $\delta$ for oriented links and prove that it is invariant under these moves. For knots, the defect equals the rank of an alternating bilinear form obtained from a Seifert matrix, so it is even. We also prove that it is additive under connected sum. Let $K_s$ be the connected sum of $s\geq 1$ copies of $9_{46}$. Then $\delta(K_s)=2s$, so these knots represent infinitely many distinct equivalence classes under the oriented moves, and none is equivalent to an unlink. After forgetting orientation, each $K_s$ can be transformed into an unlink with $2s+1$ components by $3s$ ordinary $3$-moves.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 定向链环变换的提升缺陷
analysis.workSummary: 以 Fox 三染色向九元素 Alexander quandle 染色的提升定义非负整数缺陷 δ，证明定向 t₃、t̄₆ 变换不变。对结，δ 为 Seifert 矩阵所给交错双线性型的秩，故为偶数且对连通和可加；s 个 9₄₆ 连通和满足 δ=2s，产生无限不同的定向变换类且均不等价平凡链环。忘定向后，每个例子可经 3s 次普通三变换成为 2s+1 分量平凡链环。
techniques: Fox 染色与 quandle 提升
analysis.breakthrough: 以可计算缺陷区分无限变换类，并给出忘定向后障碍消失的具体例子。
analysis.limitations: 不变性只针对指定定向变换，不能扩至无定向普通三变换；结上的偶性与可加性不应自动用于任意链环。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
